crossRefs.note: “Behold, I come quickly. Blessed is he who keeps the words of the prophecy of this book.”
The great day of Yahweh is near. It is near, and hurries greatly, the voice of the day of Yahweh. The mighty man cries…
The nations were angry, and your wrath came, as did the time for the dead to be judged, and to give your bondservants…
Tell the righteous “Good!” For they shall eat the fruit of their deeds.
Woe to the wicked! Disaster is upon them; for the deeds of his hands will be paid back to him.
Behold, the Lord Yahweh will come as a mighty one, and his arm will rule for him. Behold, his reward is with him, and…
Behold, Yahweh has proclaimed to the end of the earth, “Say to the daughter of Zion, ‘Behold, your salvation comes!…
Now he who plants and he who waters are the same, but each will receive his own reward according to his own labor.
If any man’s work remains which he built on it, he will receive a reward.
For if I do this of my own will, I have a reward. But if not of my own will, I have a stewardship entrusted to me.
What then is my reward? That when I preach the Good News, I may present the Good News of Christ without charge, so as…
I saw the dead, the great and the small, standing before the throne, and they opened books. Another book was opened…
For the Son of Man will come in the glory of his Father with his angels, and then he will render to everyone according…
who “will pay back to everyone according to their works:”
So then each one of us will give account of himself to God.

translations.web: “Behold, I come quickly. My reward is with me, to repay to each man according to his work.
translations.bsb: “Behold, I am coming soon, and My reward is with Me, to give to each one according to what he has done.
translations.kjv: And, behold, I come quickly; and my reward is with me, to give every man according as his work shall be.
translations.asv: Behold, I come quickly; and my reward is with me, to render to each man according as his work is.
